name: Surgical Oncology
shortDescription: Precision surgical management of a wide range of cancers, combining minimally invasive techniques with complex open surgery.
intro: Our Surgical Oncology department is dedicated to providing cutting-edge, compassionate care for patients battling cancer. Our team of expert surgeons specializes in the surgical management of a wide range of cancers, combining precision surgery with multidisciplinary care so each patient receives a personalized treatment plan.
points: Multidisciplinary approach with medical oncologists, radiologists and other specialists
Minimally invasive, robotic-assisted and complex open surgical techniques
Tumor removal, staging and biopsy procedures
Curative and palliative surgical care
Reconstructive surgery where tumor removal affects function or appearance
Preventive surgery for patients at high genetic risk
Patient-centred communication and support throughout treatment

name: Medical Oncology
shortDescription: Chemotherapy, immunotherapy and targeted therapy tailored to each patient, established as a dedicated department in 2019.
intro: Our medical oncology services provide comprehensive care for patients battling cancer, with a focus on personalized treatment and advanced therapies — chemotherapy, immunotherapy and targeted therapy — tailored to each patient's cancer type, stage and overall health.
points: Full spectrum of chemotherapy, immunotherapy and targeted therapy
Individualized treatment plans developed with other specialists
Supportive care: pain management, nutrition support and counselling
Patient and family education on diagnosis, treatment and side effects
Multidisciplinary coordination with surgeons and radiation oncologists
Access to clinical trials where available

name: Radiation Oncology
shortDescription: High-precision conformal radiotherapy on Elekta iBEAM® evo LINAC technology, including 3D image-guided brachytherapy.
intro: The Radiation Oncology team delivers high-precision conformal radiotherapy using the Elekta iBEAM® evo system. The department runs an active brachytherapy unit specialising in High Dose Rate (HDR) 3D Image-Guided Brachytherapy, with substantial experience in intracavitary brachytherapy for gynaecological, urethral and oesophageal cancers.
points: 3D Conformal Radiotherapy (3DCRT)
Intensity-Modulated Radiotherapy (IMRT)
RapidArc and Volumetric Modulated Arc Therapy (VMAT)
HDR 3D image-guided brachytherapy
Advanced imaging for precise tumor visualisation and planning
Adaptive radiotherapy adjusted to daily changes in the tumor
Real-time monitoring during treatment delivery

name: Gynaec & Breast Clinic
shortDescription: Diagnosis, staging and screening for gynaecological and breast cancers, backed by over 500 community awareness camps.
intro: The clinic focuses on the diagnosis and staging of gynaecological cancers and breast cancer using colposcopy and digital mammography, alongside comprehensive screening programs for early detection. The team has also conducted over 500 educational camps in colleges, schools and villages to raise cancer awareness.
points: Colposcopy for cervical, vaginal and vulval examination
Digital mammography for breast cancer screening
Diagnosis and staging of gynaecological and breast cancers
Screening programs for early detection
500+ community and institutional awareness camps conducted
Personalised treatment plans for each patient

name: Radiology
shortDescription: X-ray, CT and mammography imaging supporting early detection, diagnosis, treatment planning and follow-up.
intro: Radiology is a cornerstone of comprehensive cancer care at IRCS — from early detection with X-ray, CT and mammography, to guiding surgical and radiation treatment planning, to interventional procedures such as image-guided biopsies, and ongoing follow-up imaging to monitor treatment and detect recurrence.
points: X-ray, CT and mammography imaging for early detection
Precise assessment of tumor size, location and spread
Imaging-guided treatment planning across departments
Interventional radiology for minimally invasive biopsies
Follow-up imaging to monitor treatment effectiveness
Support for palliative care interventions

name: Pathology & Biochemistry
shortDescription: Tissue and biochemical analysis for accurate cancer diagnosis, staging and treatment monitoring.
intro: The Pathology and Biochemistry lab plays a critical role in accurate diagnosis and management of cancer — analysing tissue samples to identify cancer type and stage, and conducting blood and tissue biomarker tests to monitor the body's response to treatment.
points: Tissue sample analysis for cancer type and staging
Biochemical and biomarker testing
Early detection through advanced laboratory techniques
Monitoring of disease progression and treatment response
Timely, precise results supporting informed treatment decisions
